ActivityDiskFormattedLibrary: Formatted {0} as {1} at {2} and added it to {3}
ActivityDiskWorn: {0} has used {1}% of its rated life
ActivityScanBlocked: Blocked a library scan because {0} can't be read
ConfirmErase: Everything on {0} will be erased, including {2}, and it will be formatted as {1}. This can't be undone.
ConfirmFormat: Everything on {0} will be erased and it will be formatted as {1}. This can't be undone.
EmptyDisks: No library has a folder yet.
ErrorAddToLibrary: Done, but Jellyfin wouldn't add it to the library. Add the folder from the library's settings.
ErrorAlertOrderGigabytes: Set Storage full to less free space than Storage low.
ErrorAlertOrderPercent: Set Storage full higher than Storage low.
ErrorFolderName: Use up to 100 characters, with no slash or : * ? " < > |.
ErrorFolderRequest: Couldn't make the folder. The server log says why.
ErrorFolderTaken: A folder with that name is already on this disk.
ErrorFormatBusy: Another disk is being formatted. Try again once it finishes.
ErrorFormatFileSystem: This server can't format that file system.
ErrorFormatGone: This disk isn't unformatted anymore, so it wasn't touched.
ErrorFormatHasData: This disk holds data. Confirm erasing it to format it.
ErrorFormatLibraryDisk: This is the disk a library expects at its mount point. Mount it again instead of erasing it.
ErrorFormatName: Use up to 11 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
ErrorFormatRequest: Couldn't format the disk. The server log says why.
ErrorFormatTaken: Another disk already uses that folder. Pick another name.
HelpAlertFailing: Logs an error when SMART predicts a failure.
HelpAlertHot: Logs a warning when a disk runs too hot.
HelpAlertWorn: Logs a warning when an SSD nears the end of its life.
HelpErrorAt: Logs an error in the activity log.
HelpErrorPoint: A disk past this point is full.
HelpFolderName: Made at the top of this disk, such as Movies.
HelpFsExt4: Best for a disk that stays on this server.
HelpHotPoint: A disk past this temperature is too hot.
HelpMuteMonitoring: Ignores file changes in a missing disk's folders until it's back.
HelpOwnAlerts: Replaces the global alerts for this disk.
HelpRemount: Mounts a missing disk again at each check, waiting longer after each failed try.
HelpScanGuardAffected: Blocks a scan only when a missing disk's folders still hold files. Jellyfin skips gone and empty folders on its own.
HelpScanGuardAll: Blocks every library scan while any disk is missing or unresponsive.
HelpScanGuardOff: Lets every scan run. Items on a missing disk may be removed.
HelpScanGuardScope: Only full library scans are blocked. Scanning one library from its menu always runs.
HelpShareAddress: Where this share is mounted from, such as smb://nas/Media. Missing shares are mounted again from it.
HelpShareAddressWindows: Where this share is connected from, such as \\nas\Media. Missing shares are connected again from it.
HelpStorage: Each disk and share Jellyfin uses, for its libraries or its own folders, with its space and state. Open a disk for its details.
HelpVolumeName: Up to 11 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.
HelpWarningAt: Logs a warning in the activity log.
HelpWarningPoint: A disk past this point is low on space.
HelpWornPoint: An SSD past this much of its rated life is worn out.
IssueFailing: {0} reports a SMART failure. Back it up and replace it soon.
IssueFolders: Some library folders on {0} are missing.
IssueLow: {0} is low on space, {1}% used with {2} free.
IssueReadOnly: Jellyfin can't write to some library folders on {0}, so it can't save metadata or artwork next to the media there.
IssueServerReadOnly: Jellyfin can't write to its {0} folder, {1}.
IssueWorn: {0} has used {1}% of its rated life.
NoticeAllHealthy: Every disk your libraries use is healthy.
NoticeDiskMissingSince: Not mounted since {0}. Its library items stay until it's back.
NoticeDiskNotMounted: This disk holds data but isn't mounted, so no library can use it. Formatting erases what's on it.
NoticeDiskUnformatted: This disk has no file system yet. Format it to use it in a library.
NoticeDiskUnresponsiveSince: Unresponsive since {0}. Its library items stay until it answers again.
NoticeDiskUnused: No library has a folder on this disk.
NoticeFormatDriveLetter: Formatting erases everything on this disk, then gives it the next free drive letter.
NoticeFormatMountAt: Formatting erases everything on this disk, then mounts it at {0}.
NoticeLibraryDisk: This is the disk a library expects at {0}. It isn't mounted, so its library items can't play. Mount it again instead of erasing it.
NoticeNoDisks: None of your libraries has a folder yet.
RemountDenied: Jellyfin isn't allowed to mount disks
RemountNotMounted: it didn't show up after mounting
TaskCheckStorageDescription: Checks the space and mount state of each disk your libraries use, and records changes in the activity log.
